description: A delicious 3-day food trip to Tokyo, exploring street food, local markets, and hands-on cooking experiences.

accommodation.amenities: restaurant, spa, pool, airport shuttle, breakfast included

days.title: Arrival and Ginza Street Food Exploration
days.description: Arrive in Tokyo, check into your hotel, and immediately dive into the city's vibrant street food scene in Ginza.

activities.notes: What you'll see: Explore the bustling streets and hidden alleys of Ginza, discovering local food stalls and eateries.What to bring: Comfortable walking shoes and an appetite for adventure.What to eat: Sample a variety of Japanese street foods like takoyaki, yakitori, and taiyaki.Good to know: This tour is a great introduction to Tokyo's diverse culinary landscape.

days.title: Hands-on Cooking and Shibuya Night Market
days.description: Spend the day learning to cook Japanese dishes, followed by an evening exploring the lively Shibuya night market.

activities.activity_name: Tokyo Cooking Class with Local Chef — Afternoon Edition
activities.notes: What you'll see: Learn traditional Japanese cooking techniques from a local chef in a hands-on class.What to bring: Your enthusiasm for cooking and a camera to capture your culinary creations.What to eat: Enjoy the dishes you prepare, which might include sushi, tempura, or ramen.Good to know: This class offers a deeper understanding of Japanese cuisine and culture.

activities.activity_name: Tokyo Night Market & Tapas Crawl — Evening Edition
activities.notes: What you'll see: Experience the vibrant atmosphere of a Tokyo night market and discover various tapas-style dishes.What to bring: Cash for small purchases and an open mind for new flavors.What to eat: Indulge in a range of small plates, snacks, and local drinks.Good to know: Night markets are a fantastic way to immerse yourself in local life and food culture.

days.title: Ueno Cooking Class and Cultural Exploration
days.description: Enjoy another cooking class in Ueno, followed by some cultural exploration before preparing for departure.

activities.activity_name: Tokyo Cooking Class with Local Chef
activities.notes: What you'll see: Participate in a cooking class to learn more about Japanese culinary traditions.What to bring: Your appetite and a desire to learn new recipes.What to eat: Enjoy the delicious meal you've prepared with your own hands.Good to know: This class provides practical skills and a memorable cultural experience.

What you'll see: Explore historic landmarks and traditional neighborhoods in Tokyo.What to bring: Comfortable walking shoes and a camera to capture the sights.What to eat: While primarily a cultural tour, you might find opportunities for small snacks along the way.Good to know: This tour offers a glimpse into Tokyo's rich history and heritage.
